chapter_mission: Corellia-front reaction: Alliance fleet acceleration; Han's alignment publicly tips toward Corellia; Corellian paramilitary cells mobilize.
chapter_turn: Han stops calling his Corellian sympathies a private matter — he commits, openly, with Leia in the room.

scene_plan.purpose: Han files Corellian papers; Leia watches.
Alliance fleet acceleration order; Pellaeon and Niathal in the room.

exit_vector: Han filing Corellian registration papers on a Falcon-side datapad in front of Leia; Leia watching without objecting.
notes: The operational separation is dated to this chapter in the narrative though not enacted until Ch 22.
